Case Study: Anonymised — Logistics & Distribution Sector

How AICORE helped a Logistics & Warehousing client: A distribution company handling fast-moving consumer goods across Lagos and Abuja had no reliable method for tracking stock movements between its two ...

Challenge: A distribution company handling fast-moving consumer goods across Lagos and Abuja had no reliable method for tracking stock movements between its two warehouses. Inventory counts were done weekly by hand, reconciliation took two days, and discrepancies of 5–15% were common. The business could not reliably promise delivery timelines because it had no real-time visibility into what was physically on hand versus what the spreadsheet said.

Solution: AICORE implemented Throughport WMS — a cloud-connected warehouse management system — across both warehouse locations. All goods-in and goods-out movements were digitised using barcode scanning on Android handheld devices. Stock transfers between locations were tracked in real time. The system generated automated daily reports on stock levels, movement history, and discrepancies, and integrated with the company's existing accounting software via API.

Outcomes: Inventory discrepancy rate reduced from 12% to under 1.5% Weekly stock reconciliation time reduced from 2 days to 2 hours Order fulfilment visibility increased from next-day to real-time Theft and shrinkage detection improved through movement audit trail

Technologies: Throughport WMS, Android handhelds, Barcode scanning, PostgreSQL, REST API, React.
